Gross margin (revenues minus COGS divided by revenues) is not a meaningful metric for financial services firms.
Total revenues net of interest expense 52,862; Total expenses 41,095. Operating margin = (52,862 - 41,095) / 52,862 = 11,767 / 52,862 = 0.2247 or 22.47%
Total revenues net of interest expense 42,380; Total expenses 33,110. Operating margin = (42,380 - 33,110) / 42,380 = 9,270 / 42,380 = 0.2187 or 21.87%
Operating margin 2022: 22.47%; Operating margin 2021: 21.87%. Change = 22.47% - 21.87% = 0.60 percentage points, or 2.75% relative improvement. Absolute percentage point change = 0.60 ppts.
